persona_snapshot.name: Soft-spoken non-technical user
persona_snapshot.summary: Quiet and unsure, apologizes for bothering anyone, and doesn't push back.
persona_snapshot.speaking_style: Quiet and hesitant. Starts with "sorry" or "um", trails off, and rarely says what they want twice.

scenario_snapshot.title: Forgotten mailbox password
scenario_snapshot.description: The caller forgot a mailbox password. The bot sends a reset link and never handles a password itself.
scenario_snapshot.goal: You forgot the password for your work email and need to get back in.

beats.instruction: Say you forgot the password for your email address.
beats.checkpoint: The caller said they forgot their password.

beats.instruction: Give your mailbox address, then your billing zip and PIN when asked.
Say yes to a password reset, and ask where the link is going.
beats.checkpoint: The caller accepted a password reset.

must.text: Verify the caller before resetting the password.
Tell the caller the reset link went to their contact email.

must_not.text: Say a password aloud or ask for one.

expected_state.description: A password reset was issued today.
